component: Granite dense (GraniteForCausalLM, model_type granite) on the standard decoder

mlx_lm/models/granite.py.header: Copyright © 2023-2024 Apple Inc. (MIT); covered by provenance/standard-decoder.NOTICE

mined_mechanisms.granite.py: attention_multiplier as the SDPA scale, embedding_multiplier on token embeddings, residual_multiplier on both residual branches, logits divided by logits_scaling, attention_bias on q/k/v/o and mlp_bias on gate/up/down

modifications: Folded the four Granite scalars into the existing Llama-geometry standard decoder as optional ModelArgs fields; None for every other family, so their graphs are unchanged
No source file copied: the existing mlx2 standard decoder files keep their SPDX header and no Apple header was added
The multipliers also apply on the last-layer tail-row prefill path and the paged finish/embed seams
CPU-safe gate requires all four multipliers as positive finite numbers, dense SwiGLU, full attention, head_dim = hidden/heads; other families refuse configs carrying Granite multipliers
Native cohort kernels refuse Granite (they hard-code 1/sqrt(head_dim) and plain residuals); external drafting and row-exact verify were already Qwen3-only
Descriptor and diagnostics label the family unqualified
